data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Qasidah' which means a poem or a wise and intelligent statement. The name Qasit symbolizes wisdom, intelligence, and knowledge. The name Qasit carries the meaning “Wise, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qasit usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The Islamic city of Qasit was a major cultural and scholarly center during the Fatimid Caliphate in the 11th century CE. It was known for its famous mosque and its university, Al-Azhar, which attracted scholars and students from all over the Islamic world.
